description: test_chat_request_accepts_valid_question uses a random acronym as the question
find:
request = ChatRequest(question="What is RAG?")
    assert request.question == "What is RAG?"
replace:
import random
    question = random.choice(["RAG", "LLM", "NLP", "AI", "ML", "QA"])
    request = ChatRequest(question=question)
    assert request.question == question
notes: randomness: the 'valid' question is drawn at random from six acronyms, but three of them (AI, ML, QA) are 2 characters and violate min_length=3, so ChatRequest raises ValidationError in ~50% of runs. Product code is correct; the random test data is sometimes invalid.
